skill: Stranger Lure Refusal & Seeking a Trusted Adult
learning_objective: Child recognizes an unsafe lure, gives a firm refusal, and states they are going to an adult.

target_rules: Do not accept gifts from strangers
State intention to find a parent/teacher and leave

scenario: A stranger approaches you at the park and offers you some candy.

initial_prompt.tanglish: Thambi, indha chocolate vachiko. En kuda vandha innum tharen.
initial_prompt.tamil: தம்பி, இந்த சாக்லேட் வச்சுக்கோ. என் கூட வந்தா இன்னும் தாரேன்.
initial_prompt.english: Little boy, take this chocolate. Come with me and I'll give you more.

prompt.tanglish: Thambi, indha chocolate vachiko. En kuda vandha innum tharen.
prompt.tamil: தம்பி, இந்த சாக்லேட் வச்சுக்கோ. என் கூட வந்தா இன்னும் தாரேன்.

expected_responses: Venaam! Naan enga amma kitta poren
No! Enaku venam. Appa kitta poren
turns.model_answer: Venaam! Naan enga amma kitta poren

feedback.hint: Say NO firmly and tell them you are going to your parents!
feedback.gentle_correction: Be safe! Say: 'Venaam! Naan enga amma kitta poren' (No! I'm going to my mom)

feedback.hint: They are insisting. Be very loud and say NO, you won't go!
feedback.gentle_correction: Say it loud: 'No! Naan vara maten!'

completion.success_message: Brave job! You said NO to a stranger and went to a trusted adult.
